view: Close three-quarter archaeological object study Sanxingdui bronze mask broad face angular ears projecting cylindrical eyes, green patina and earth traces, securely resting on plain padded surface, actual cast mask hollow not living face, no gold fantasy ornament.

eras.title: A face cast in bronze
eras.caption: Sanxingdui's pits contained bronze masks, figures and other carefully made objects. Their striking forms revealed a Bronze Age artistic tradition in Sichuan that differed from the better-known centres of the central plains.
